description: This file defines the VSCodeCommitMessageAdapter class, which implements commit message generation and repository detection within VSCode, utilizing VSCode APIs and custom orchestrator and generator classes.

classes.name: VSCodeCommitMessageAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for generating commit messages within VSCode, managing repository detection and progress reporting.
